rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose third-person pronoun for a salient object, animal, baby, or child.

example.english: This computer is broken; it keeps turning itself off.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦壞咗，佢成日自己熄機。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2 keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 gei2 sik1 gei1

rows.note: Use this identification construction when saying who someone is, including on the phone.

example.english: Hello, it is me; do you recognize me?
example.jyutping: wai2 hai6 ngo5 aa3 nei5 jing6 dak1 ngo5 maa3

rows.note: Use this colloquial euphemism when “it” refers to sexual activity.

example.english: They had sex at the hotel last night; do not tell anyone about it.
example.traditional: 佢哋尋晚喺酒店搞嘢，唔好同人講。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 cam4 maan5 hai2 zau2 dim3 gaau2 je5 m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2

rows.note: Use this when “it” means that there is no more or that this is all.

example.english: Our shop only has this much stock today; once it sells out, there is no more of it.
example.traditional: 我哋今日得咁多貨，賣晒就冇喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 dak1 gam3 do1 fo3 maai6 saai3 zau6 mou5 laa3
